cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(flow_opcua_pubsub_peer C)
set(UA_ENABLE_PUBSUB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(UA_ENABLE_PUBSUB_INFORMATIONMODEL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(UA_ENABLE_PUBSUB_ENCRYPTION ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(UA_ENABLE_ENCRYPTION MBEDTLS CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(UA_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(UA_BUILD_UNIT_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${OPEN62541_SOURCE} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/open62541)
add_executable(opcua-pubsub-peer peer.c)
target_link_libraries(opcua-pubsub-peer open62541)
